purpose: Define the fixed correction-operator contract required before the selected atomic predictive-v1 lane can move from same-source-family diagnostics to validation.
required_model_form: E_or_nu_pred = standard_baseline(domain, constants, quantum_numbers) + delta_uet_or_ci(domain, locked_parameters, quantum_numbers)

required_outputs.name: delta_frequency_or_wavelength
required_outputs.unit: Hz or angstrom after declared conversion

operator_contract.parameter_lock_rule: All correction parameters must be declared in this manifest or a child manifest before any holdout/external rows are evaluated.
operator_contract.holdout_exclusion_rule: Rows in helium_quantum_defect_holdout_sources.json and external_holdouts/chianti_he_i/source_manifest.json must not set correction parameters.
operator_contract.uncertainty_rule: The operator must emit parameter/model uncertainty or a source-backed reason why uncertainty is not computable before validation thresholds can be reclassified.

operator_candidates.reason: delta_selected_series is fitted from selected same-source-family helium levels and does not predict quantum defects from a CI/correlated or UET operator.

operator_candidates.required_artifact: CI/correlated helium level residual gate with parameters frozen before holdout evaluation
UET atomic Hamiltonian/transition-operator derivation with units, fixed parameters, and source-backed residual lane

pass_conditions_for_validation_upgrade: At least one accepted_as_delta_uet_or_ci operator candidate is implemented.
All accepted operator parameters are frozen before holdout evaluation.
The operator emits level/line residuals and uncertainty fields consumed by the threshold gate.
Non-NIST independent He I holdout rows are available and excluded from calibration.
Diagnostic thresholds are replaced or reclassified as validation-ready before independent rows are evaluated.
blocked_claims: the current empirical quantum-defect lane is the fixed CI/UET correction operator
delta_uet_or_ci exists because the model equation is specified
same-source-family diagnostic residuals validate the missing correction operator
a future correction operator may be fitted after seeing holdout or CHIANTI residuals
claim_boundary: This manifest defines the fixed correction-operator contract and records that no accepted delta_uet_or_ci operator is implemented yet. It does not validate atomic spectra.
